title: gameWorkspaceSection
responsibility: Selects the workspace section allowed by the current level plan.

inputs.name: gameWorkspaceSection.view
inputs.description: Current level; undefined means no plan. No default is supplied.

inputs.name: gameWorkspaceSection.tab
inputs.description: Requested workspace section; no default is supplied.

outputs.name: gameWorkspaceSection
outputs.description: Requested section when allowed, otherwise Level for an unfinished plan or Checkpoints for an unplanned Level tab.

errors.name: Input access failure
errors.description: Errors from supplied planning getters or LevelValidator access propagate unchanged.
